title: Connect return payload
description: The payload of a connect return, the exact JSON bytes the adapter signed. Its members come in no set order: the return carries the exact bytes signed, and the control plane parses those bytes. A connect return is the payload in base64url without padding, a dot, and the signature in base64url without padding, at most 1024 characters with no white space; the signature is 64 bytes of Ed25519 under the adapter's enrolled access key over qory-connect-return-ed25519-v1, a line feed and the payload bytes. The domain line keeps the signature from verifying as a request's signature or as a connect pass's. The adapter mints a return only after it has verified a connect pass (connect-pass.schema.json), its signature under a server key the adapter pinned and its adapter_id, so connection_id and nonce are the ones the control plane signed. It sends the person's browser back with a 303 to the control plane's /integrations/{connection_id}?return=<the return>, with Referrer-Policy: no-referrer. The adapter sends the browser to the control plane origin it enrolled with, never to one taken from the request, a parameter or the pass. The return carries no id or name from the source. Before it changes anything, the control plane checks: the signature, under that adapter's live access key; that connection_id equals the one in the URL, and names a connection of that adapter that is pending; that nonce equals the nonce of the latest connect pass for that connection and the nonce bound to the person's session; that expires_at has not passed on its clock, and that no return with this nonce was accepted before, since a return is single-use; and that the signed-in person is the one who started connecting. linked makes the connection (connection_id in definitions.schema.json). refused and cancelled leave it pending and change nothing. What the person sees when a check fails is the control plane's page, not this contract.

connection_id.description: The connection the person was making, as the connect pass named it.

nonce.description: The nonce of the connect pass the adapter verified, as the pass carried it.

outcome.description: linked, the adapter linked the grant the source confirmed to connection_id; refused, the adapter linked nothing, for reason; cancelled, the person stopped at the source, and the adapter linked nothing.

reason.description: Why the adapter refused, present only when outcome is refused: person_not_permitted, the person does not administer the account the grant belongs to at the source; grant_taken, the grant is already linked to another live connection; grant_not_confirmed, the source did not confirm the grant for this flow; grant_suspended, the source has suspended the grant; permission_missing, the grant lacks a permission the adapter needs; pass_expired, the pass reached the adapter after its expires_at, or more than 15 minutes ahead of it; source_unavailable, the source did not answer, so the adapter could not confirm the grant.

expires_at.description: When the return expires, RFC 3339 in UTC with whole seconds, at most 300 seconds after the adapter made it. The control plane refuses a return whose expires_at has passed on its clock.
